title: feat(app-shell): an object list's title names the object ahead of the view switcher
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoS8upiKFfSUfnU5rfNgvNej)_

Fixes #27950

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对象列表页标题从「我的线索 ▾ · 12」变为「线索 / 我的线索 ▾ · 12」，对象复数名在视图切换器前面，点击回到该对象的默认列表；手机顶栏的视图切换按钮同样读作「线索 / 我的线索」。
- 为什么改：侧栏收起或从链接直接打开列表时，页面上没有文字说明这是哪个对象；按维护者裁决 B（页头对象名前置视图切换器，窄列表对象名优先保留）。
- 风险与回滚：只动 Console 列表页标题这一处界面，不碰顶栏 AppHeader、记录页与任何元数据；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewPageHeader.tsx`（`ObjectListTitle` 与 `title` 的三种取值）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewViewCrud.tsx`（手机按钮文字）、新测试 `ObjectView.objectListTitle-27950.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.objectListTitle-27950.test.tsx`，预期 9 个测试全过；或在 Console 打开 CRM 线索的任一视图，标题左侧可见「线索 /」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The maintainer's ruling B on #27950 (comment 6539906268), verbatim: 「#27950 裁 B：页头对象名前置视图切换器；窄列表下对象名优先保留、视图名截断或换行、计数可省」.

- **Page header** (`objectViewPageHeader.tsx`): when the list has a view switcher, the title is 「OBJECT / VIEW ▾ · COUNT」. The object's plural label (the reader's language, through `objectPluralLabel`) comes first, as a link to `/apps/APP/OBJECT`. That bare address opens the reader's pinned view, or else the declared default. Off an app route it is plain text.
  - A view with no `label` is already called by the plural (objectui#12774). Its title stays the switcher alone, so the object is named once and never as 「Leads / Leads」.
  - With no view to switch, the title is the plural, as before.
- **Narrow rows** (the split pane's narrowed list, #27545): the object label is `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap`. The view label is the switcher's own `truncate` span inside a `min-w-0` row, so the view label is cut first and the object label never is. The count stays: it is a few characters, and the ruling makes dropping it optional.
- **Phone** (`objectViewViewCrud.tsx`): the page header is not drawn below `sm`. The app bar's view switcher trigger now receives `triggerLabel` 「OBJECT / VIEW」 through the existing `MobileViewSwitcherContext` field. That span truncates its end, so the view label gives way before the object's. A label-less view keeps the plain label. `AppHeader.tsx` is not touched.
- `useObjectViewTitleSwitcher` also returns the `titleLabel` it already computed, and `ObjectView` passes it and the object list href to the header.
- Docs: `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` › Switching views. Changeset: `.changeset/27950-object-list-title-names-object.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.objectListTitle-27950.test.tsx` (9 cells, real `ObjectView` → plugin `ObjectView` → `ListView` chain, the `ObjectView.titleViewSwitcher-27594` harness):

- On the object's address and on a view's address, the heading reads `Leads` then the switcher. The label is an `A` with `href="/apps/crm/crm_lead"`, and following it opens the default view.
- With the sidebar expanded and collapsed (the real `SidebarProvider`; `useSidebar().state` is read back as `expanded` / `collapsed`), the object label is drawn exactly once.
- A record open beside the list (split preference, `?recordId=`) gives one object label and one switcher.
- A label-less view: no crumb, and the switcher reads `Notes`.
- The narrow-row classes decide the cut: the crumb is `shrink-0` + `whitespace-nowrap`, and the view label is `truncate`.
- The phone trigger reads `Leads / My Leads`.

The record route's crumb is not drawn by this page: `RecordDetailView` is a separate route chunk. The existing `AppHeader.appBarLeftGroup-12461` cells ("an object's view and record routes draw no crumb either") pin the app bar, and they pass unchanged in the run below.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, WRAP mode, under os-verify-lock, trap restore)</summary>

No dist leg: the suite imports `./ObjectView` from source.

| leg | mutation | result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | title back to the switcher alone | `Tests 7 failed / 2 passed (9)` (the label-less and phone cells stay green) |
| A2 | phone `triggerLabel` dropped | `Tests 1 failed / 8 passed (9)` |
| A3 | crumb class `shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap` → `min-w-0 truncate` | `Tests 1 failed / 8 passed (9)` |
| A4 | label-less guard removed | `Tests 1 failed / 8 passed (9)` |

Every leg: `ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0`. Every restore: `blob == HEAD` (`objectViewPageHeader.tsx` 540eb8ba8885, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx` a05153fc75e3) and `git diff HEAD` empty. These ablations ran at the pre-merge head, where both files were byte-identical to the final head.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The card's original file surface (`AppHeader.tsx`) was replaced by the ruling. The diff lands in `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`, `objectViewViewCrud.tsx`, `objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx` (one returned value) and `ObjectView.tsx` (two props), as the decision comment's 裁后执行 line named.
- Seat 1's #28242 (header action pressed state) works on the header's actions cluster. This diff touches only the `title` prop of the same `PageHeader` call in `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`, a different region.
- The phone bar's trigger is still capped at 180px by `AppHeader`. An object plural longer than that would itself be cut. No authored object in this tree comes close, and widening the cap is `AppHeader`'s, outside this ruling.
- No new i18n key: the separator is a glyph (`aria-hidden`), and the link's name is the object's own label.
- Not taken: a browser reading at 1440 / 464 / 390 px. The test DOM computes no layout, so the narrow-row behaviour is pinned by the classes that decide it. The landing seat may take the reading.
